title: norite member --json
description:
The machine-readable output of `norite member list`, `update`, `remove`, and `role add` and `role remove`.

Versioned source of truth (CLAUDE.md rule 15): a change to what these commands print ships with a change to this file in the same commit. The shapes are the CLI's, re-declared from the instance's rather than passed through. Every nullable field is present and null, every list is [] rather than null, and every string an instance sent is exactly as sent, with what a terminal would act on escaped as \uXXXX.

guild_id.description: A Snowflake ID, as a decimal string.

user_id.description: A Snowflake ID, as a decimal string.

items.description: A Snowflake ID, as a decimal string.

roles.description: The ids of the roles the member holds, @everyone aside.

memberPage.description: A page of members, in id order.

next.description: The id to pass to --after for the next page, or null on the last page: a page shorter than --limit.
